changes: Redesigned the Logs tab to mimic the app's own Settings sheet rather than the rest of the Content Manager's serif/gold theme: sans-serif system font throughout, larger text, and flat full-height rows in place of the small boxed card. Change lists are now numbered (1, 2, 3…) instead of bulleted. The panel now cancels the surrounding padding so it runs edge-to-edge and fills the remaining screen height.

Replaced the header's gear/hamburger icon (was the ⚙/☰ unicode characters, which iOS renders as a glossy 3D emoji-style glyph) with a flat, simple, single-color SVG gear/lines icon that follows the site's gold color exactly.

Fixed the gear icon overlapping the Content Manager's Exit button: the gear sits at a fixed top-right position with a high z-index (so it stays reachable from any screen, including Manage), which the new sticky Content Manager header didn't leave room for. The header now reserves space on the right for it, and Exit is wider with more breathing room.

Content Manager header simplified: Exit button now just reads "Exit" instead of "Exit Content Manager", and the version badge now matches the "Content Manager" title's font (Cinzel) instead of a different serif.
